_about: Drills de escuta. O app fala o texto na voz/sotaque indicado; o aluno transcreve; o app compara palavra a palavra. 'lexicon' = as palavras-alvo que precisam ser reconhecidas. difficulty 1–3 (velocidade e densidade).

drills.text: The tap in the bathroom won't stop dripping, and the boiler's making a banging noise.
The faucet is leaking under the sink and there's water pooling on the floor.
We found droppings inside the kitchen cupboards this morning, and there is a very strong odour coming from the drain.
Mate, the lockbox code the host sent doesn't work, and it's half past eleven at night with the kids in the car.
The whole flat smells musty, there's black mould on the bathroom ceiling, and the extractor fan doesn't work at all.
The listing said there was a cot, but there's no cot, and the sofa bed is completely broken.
I reported it to the host straight away, he said he'd send someone round, nobody came, and now it's been three days with no hot water and the radiators stone cold.
We woke up covered in bites and I'm pretty sure it's bed bugs — I've got photos of the mattress seams.
The AC unit is only blowing warm air, the water pressure in the shower is very low, and the intercom downstairs is not responding to anyone.
The host cancelled on us two days before check-in, and now everything nearby is double the price.
Look, I'm not trying to be difficult, but the place was filthy — sticky worktops, hair in the plughole, and the bins hadn't been emptied.
There's a wasp nest right above the front door and my daughter is allergic.
I'm a host, and the guest left the place trashed — a cracked countertop, a dented fridge door, and cigarette smell in every room.
The directions were wrong altogether — it sent us to the wrong side of the estate, and the buzzer for number twelve does nothing.
The geyser burst in the night and the whole passage is flooded; we've had to move to a guest house.
Kindly note that we have raised the request already; the amount is showing as pending only.
The tumble dryer's knackered, the hob's only got one ring working, and the cooker hood's hanging off the wall.
The trash wasn't taken out and there are roaches in the pantry.
The ute's blocking the driveway and the host reckons it's not his problem.
I have been calling since morning, nobody is picking, and the light has gone off in the whole compound.
The immersion's not working so there's no hot water, and the place is freezing.
I'd like to dispute the decision — I've got an itemised receipt and a quote from the plumber.
Are you going to reimburse me for the hotel? I'm out of pocket four hundred dollars.
The robot at the corner is out, so it's chaos, and we've been sitting in traffic for an hour.
The flat is on the second floor but there is no lift, and my mother cannot climb; the listing did not mention this anywhere.
The smoke alarm's been chirping all night, there's exposed wiring by the kettle, and honestly it doesn't feel safe.
We've had no reply from the host since yesterday afternoon, the check-in was meant to be four o'clock, and it's now gone nine.
I'm gonna be honest with you, I already filed a chargeback with my bank, so I just need to know where this stands.
The gate man said he was not informed about any guest, so we could not enter.
Grand, so — if you can just send that in writing, I'll leave it with you, but I do need to hear back by tomorrow.
